title: Law to create a legacy business registry and grants
summary: This bill would direct the Department of Small Business Services to set up a registry recognizing businesses that have operated in a New York City neighborhood for at least 20 years, based on nominations from the mayor, public advocate, borough presidents or Council members. It also creates a Legacy Business Preservation Fund to give grants to these businesses and to landlords who sign them to 10-year leases, when the business faces a significant risk of being displaced. The agency would report annually on which businesses are designated and which grants are awarded.
